obfuscation_indicators: considerable amount of judgment and estimate
increased sales volumes of certain products
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, with clear segment-level sales, margin, acquisition, and capital expenditure data. Key risks include declining Industrial and Health & Nutrition sales, customer destocking, dependence on raw-material cost movements and LIFO accounting, acquisition valuation assumptions, and a $7.7 million PCB-related environmental liability. Overall tone is moderately positive due to improved gross profit and EPS, although results benefited from favorable cost changes and acquisitions.
